lyrics.text:
O holy night
the stars are
brightly shining

It is the night
of dear Savior
birth

Long lay the world
in sin and error
pinning

Till Heappeared
and the soul
felt its worth

A thrill of hope
the weary world
rejoices

For yonder breaks
a new glorious
morn

Fall on your knees
oh hear the angels
voices

O night devine
o night when
Christ was born

O night devine
o night
o night divine
